warnings.label: Tidal Thames riverside from Putney Bridge to Teddington Weir
warnings.description: Tidal Thames riverside from Putney Bridge to Teddington Weir
warnings.county: Greater London, Hammersmith and Fulham, Hounslow, Richmond upon Thames, Wandsworth
warnings.eaArea: Kent, South London and East Sussex
warnings.message:
High tides overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 02:15 AM to 04:15 AM on Saturday 10th October. 
The forecast high tide at Richmond is 4.70 mAOD at 03:15 AM on 10/10/2026.

We believe there is a possibility of flooding for Putney Embankment (SW15), Chiswick Mall and Strand on the Green (W4), Thames Bank at Mortlake (SW14), Ranelagh Drive (TW1), Friars Lane and Water Lane (TW9), Riverside and The Embankment at Twickenham, and the Towpath below Teddington Lock. Flooding of properties is not expected.

Astronomical tide levels are rising. The river flow at Teddington Weir is 4 cubic metres per second and is steady. We anticipate the flows to remain steady for the next few days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Saturday 10 October or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Hunstanton coast in Norfolk
warnings.message:
Strong winds and large waves tomorrow morning may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from from 04:30am to 08:30am on Saturday 10th October.
Locations most affected will be low lying land and roads near rivers or on the coast, with spray being seen on the seafront paths. Flood gates in the area will be closed by the Local Authority which will make access difficult. Please take notice of the Flood Sign at the top of South Beach Road. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at King's Lynn of 4.02mAODN at 06:30am, on 10 October, which is  0.15m above tide tables, Wind Force 6,  Westerley. The high tide tomorrow at 19:15pm is expected to also be above flood alert thresholds.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded.  
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Saturday 10 October or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Somerset coast at Porlock Weir
warnings.message:
High tides tomorrow evening may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 17:30 to 19:30 on 10/10/2026 
Flooding is forecast to affect locations at Porlock Bay, with low lying land and roads expected to be most affected, particularly around the coastline between Gore Point and Hurlstone Point including Porlock Weir. The highest tide is at 18:30 on Saturday 10/10/2026 with a peak height of 6.19m and a F5 westerly wind. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.   
This message will be updated by 10:00AM on Sunday 11 October or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: The tidal Deben estuary
warnings.message:
High tides overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on consecutive tides from 11pm on Friday 9th October through to 1am on Saturday 10th October. 
Tide levels will be high around the boat yard in Felixstowe Ferry hamlet at the end of Ferry Road, and along riverside areas in Woodbridge and Waldringfield, as well as in surrounding marshland. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at Harwich of 2.60mAODN at 12am, on Saturday 10th October, which is 0.5m above tide tables, Wind Force 6, Westerly. Tides will remain high over the next couple of days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Saturday 10 October or as the situation changes.
